title: What are Promoted Ads?
description: Learn about Promoted Only Posts and how they work within your ad campaigns to reach targeted audiences.

runs: What are Promoted Only Posts?

Promoted only Posts are only shown to users targeted in your ad campaigns. Unless specifically targeted, they do not show up on your followers' timelines and are not visible in search results. However, because Promoted onlyPosts are live, they are viewable by our data partners who have access to all live Posts for analysis purposes.
Promoted only Posts are made within your ads account. When seen by a targeted user, they function just like normal Posts and can receive replies, be shared, Reposted, and liked.
Where?
Promoted only Posts are shown to the people you target in your campaigns. They are not shown to your followers, unless you specifically target them in your campaign. If you choose to
, it will not be published until the date and time you specify.

While Promoted only Posts are effectively hidden, they are still “live” Posts. This means if you mention a >x< user in your Post (e.g. “Hi @>x<”), that user will receive a notification that they were mentioned along with a direct link to the Post. In addition, because Promoted only Post are live, they're also viewable by our data partners who have access to all live Post for analysis purposes.
How?

Promoted only Posts, like all Promoted Ads, can be created from your >x< Ads account, either from the main Post composer in the "Creatives" > "Posts" tab, or during campaign creation. Any >x< Ads user with the ability to compose Posts can create Promoted only Posts.

If you are the account owner, you have the choice to select or deselect “Promoted only” under delivery options. If the "Promoted only" box is not selected, the Post will be sent to your followers as a normal, organic Post.
